Financial clarity

The Financial Clarity Kit

Make your money support your life.

$14.99 USD · planned launch price

An editable toolkit in development for understanding your month, noticing spending patterns and choosing realistic savings priorities. The aim is a clearer relationship with everyday money, with practical organization rather than investment advice.

Interior previews will be added when the product is ready.

This workbook has not been released. Features and Excel / Google Sheets compatibility require completion and testing.

THOUGHTFULLY PUT TOGETHER

What's inside.

  • Planned monthly overview of income, commitments and money remaining
  • Planned planned-versus-actual expense categories and spending review
  • Planned subscription audit with renewal dates and cancellation reminders
  • Planned savings goals connected to a realistic monthly contribution
  • Planned month-end reflection: what changed, what worked and what to adjust
